name: Star-delta transition controller
summary: Coordinates the documented change from starting winding connection to running connection.
description: Coordinates the documented change from starting winding connection to running connection. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Start sequence and timing” at the input and “Star and delta commands” at the output. Transition arrangement must match the actual motor starter.
